note: vespera_inprocess: bidirectional streaming no longer adds content-type: application/json to a request that declares Content-Length: 0 (the buffered paths never defaulted an empty body). The crate docs, AGENTS.md and the bridge README now explain the CSRF implication of the default: axum Json<T> accepts a cross-site simple request that sends no Content-Type, so rely on Spring CSRF protection, SameSite cookies or an Origin / Sec-Fetch-Site check. Test fixes: the spawned-dispatch inline-pull test runs on a multi-thread runtime so it guards the task-id rule, the allocation budgets are the exact measured counts per feature set, and the detached-body test can no longer hang. The extreme bench installs its limits before route_table and skips the thread-scaling report under --list, test mode or a non-matching filter.
